text:
Maya: Heads-up — SF peer workshop confirmed for May 6. We have a tabletop + 10-minute demo slot. Need owners for speaker submission, table setup/AV, swag orders, and lead routing. Shipping cutoff Apr 30. Who can take speaker submission by EOD?

Vikram: I can own the speaker submission. Will adapt the latency-at-scale deck to a concise 10-min demo. Any slide limit target? Also need a contact for AV.

Eli: I got AV. We'll need a small monitor (15-17") for demo, 2 lav mics, power strip, and gaffer tape. Can set up an arrival checklist. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Perfect. Swag inventory: 300 stickers, 200 postcards, 150 mystery items. @Tia who's our standard vendor for the mystery items and timelines?

Tia: Ordering now — vendor is swagworks.co. PO #PO-5823. ETA May 3. Recommend reducing mystery items to 100 to stay under target spend.

Maya: Budget OK with 100. Updated the workshop sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1xyz-WorkshopPlan (please update shipping rows). Lead capture plan: use badge scanner + QR that points to a short form. Route submissions to HubSpot list "SF Workshop" -> assign to Eli for first 48 hours -> then SDR rotation. Also log raw leads in the sheet. Vikram, can you add UTM params to the demo link?

Vikram: Done. Demo link uses ?utm_source=sf_peer_workshop&utm_campaign=may6_demo

Maya: We should hand out a 1-page micro-benchmark that highlights cost vs latency tradeoffs and a 3-bullet recommendation for integration. Sophia — can you draft that by Apr 25?

Sophia: Yep — will draft the one-pager. Need the latest perf charts (2 token baseline + 1K token tail).

eng-runtime-bot: Chart uploaded: https://drive.re/redwood/bench/may_workshop_latency_q1.png

Eli: Who's on shipping manifest and onsite receipt? I can receive onsite but need pickup contact and tracking. Also we should finalise table layout (stickers left, postcards right, one stack for swag grab-bag).

Tia: Shipping contact is Aaron at ShipFast, tracking XZ123456789. I'll DM Aaron and confirm hold-for-pickup window. I'll attach shipping manifest to the sheet.

Maya: OK final action items: Vikram = speaker submission & UTM, Sophia = one-pager, Tia = vendor + shipping + PO, Eli = AV + onsite lead handling. I'll schedule a dry run on May 4 @ 10am and create a runbook. Quick Zapier mapping for leads (for reference):
```
trigger: badge_scanner_webhook
action: POST https://hooks.hubspot.com/forms/v1/submit
payload: {"source":"sf_peer_workshop","owner":"eli","utm_campaign":"may6_demo"}
```
Maya: Also plan for 300 walk-by stickers and ~60 demo handouts. Layout/arrival checklist to follow in the sheet. :thumbsup:
